lines.text: Did you know? Tend is Latin for stretch.
Quick quiz! Which means before plus stretch?

words.ex: The children pretended to be pirates.
There was tension between the two teams before the match.
He has a tendency to talk too fast.

publish.title: Tend root: pretend, tension and tendency
publish.value: Tend comes from Latin "tendere" (to stretch). Words: pretend, tension and tendency. pretend = pre + tend.
